# tiny-log
# Zero-dependency structured logging for Python.
# Built on stdlib logging + json only. Single file. MIT licensed.
# Current version: 0.5.0 (2026-10-05)

tiny-log is a single-file structured logger that emits JSON or pretty-printed
text, with context binding, log levels, rotation hooks, and correlation IDs.
v0.5.0 adds an optional secret redaction bridge that integrates with
tiny-secret-mask to scrub credentials, JWTs, and PII from every log line
before it hits a sink or an LLM context window.

Public API:
- configure(level=INFO, json=None, color=True, stream=None, redact=False)
- get_logger(name=None)
- LogContext(**values) - context manager for correlation IDs
- current_context() / snapshot()
- TinyLogAsync - async info/error/warning/debug wrappers
- log_call / log_call_async - timing decorators
- color(name) / json_field(data) / bytes_human(n) - field formatters
- ColoredString - ANSI-coloured log field (preserved in JSON output)
- SamplingHandler - downsample noisy paths
- file_handler(filename, max_bytes, backup_count) - RotatingFileHandler wrapper
- new_request_id(length=16) / new_trace_id() - ID generators

v0.5.0 redaction bridge (tiny_log_v050.py sidecar):
- get_redactor() - returns the active SecretMask
- redact_value(v) / redact_payload(payload) - redaction helpers
- RedactFilter - logging.Filter subclass
- install_json_redact_bridge() - bridges REDACT sentinel into json.JSONEncoder
- safe_log(logger, level, msg, *args, extra=..., redact=True)

Install:
- pip install tiny-log                       # core, zero deps
- pip install tiny-log[redact]               # adds tiny-secret-mask
- Or copy tiny_log.py + tiny_log_v050.py - single file(s), zero required deps

Repo: https://github.com/hussain-alsaibai/tiny-log
